comment: Bytes, regression ceilings — tighten only. Set just above the measured values after text/tailwindcss support (engine 64168 min / ~20.2k gz; was 60707/18784 after the ordering pass — the delta is the @theme/@apply scanner and the usercss pipeline). ~70% of the minified engine is string data (the Tailwind v4 property/keyword vocabulary, packed statics, PROP_ORDER/VARIANT_ORDER), leaving ~19KB of actual code. The gz numbers are the network-relevant ones: full stack ~28KB gz vs ~200KB for the UnoCSS stack it replaces.
